mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag != '1') ORDER BY request_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (id, channel, official_account, session_id, client_id, del_flag, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{channel}, #{officialAccount}, #{sessionId}, #{clientId}, '0', NOW(), 'SYS', NOW(), 'SYS')
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET user_id = #{userId}, official_account = #{officialAccount}, session_id = #{sessionId}, client_id = #{clientId}, channel = #{channel}, status = #{status}, request_time = #{requestTime}, close_time = #{closeTime}, priority = #{priority}, agent_id = #{agentId}, agent_name = #{agentName}, is_transfer_agent = #{isTransferAgent}, current_reply_status = #{currentReplyStatus}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, del_flag = #{delFlag}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE conversation SET status = '2', close_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
